build.prompt: Run ./build.sh. It fails with one error. Look at the source line the error points to and reply with only the full text of that source line.

correlate.prompt: In api.log find the request that got status 502. Then find in worker.log which job handled that request. Reply with only the job id.

fixrerun.prompt: Run ./test.sh, fix the bug it reports in src/calc.ts, run ./test.sh again, and reply with only the number of tests that passed on the final run.

deps.prompt: In deps.json find the package that has a GPL-3.0 license. Then find which file under src imports it. Reply with only that file path.
